ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the lower part is the ground area, the middle is the atmosphere and absorbing components such as carbon dioxide and water vapor, and the upper part is labeled with areas such as directed toward outer space; the arrows represent different radiation directions.
